_doc: V5 production profile (2026-11-17): one skin (v5-toon), body layer only (no muscle highlight in V5). Derivatives are identical to profiles/default.json so V5 packages have the same files, sizes, fps and names as V4 default. Read by tools/v5/render-masters-v5.mjs and tools/action-package-v3/compose.py --profile <this file>. Never edit after it produced packages (outputs record its sha256).
